# RootSink supplement

*Generated by `infra/paper/build_supplement.py` from release 1.0.9. Do not edit by hand.*

The paper refers to these tables as S1 to S5. Tiers are named as in the paper; the data stores
them in `label_confidence_tier` as `gold` (Reproduced), `gold-upstream` (Upstream), `silver`
(Partial) and `bronze` (Candidate). Terms follow the paper; `docs/DATASHEET.md` maps
each term to its field in `data/release/dataset.jsonl`.

## S3. Patch scorer outcomes on the Reproduced tier

| outcome | Reproduced-tier records |
|---|---:|
| scored | 1730 |
| ready (unmodified build crashes, developer's fix passes) | 1238 |
| developer's fix did not apply with exact context | 269 |
| developer's fix applied only with shifted context | 64 |
| developer's fix did not build | 26 |
| developer's fix applied and built, crash remained | 123 |
| unmodified source could not be rebuilt | 10 |
| of these: package no longer served / dependency changed / build script not re-runnable | 4 / 2 / 4 |

The Reproduced tier replays the binary shipped in ARVO's image, so a record whose source the scorer cannot
rebuild stays Reproduced-tier; its rebuild log is archived under `data/evidence/score/`. ARVO's fixed image,
which the Reproduced tier runs, differs from the vulnerable image plus the developer's fix in all but
3 of 109 measured failures and all but 1 of
29 ready images. The optional coverage check rejects a patch whose libFuzzer feature
coverage of the seed corpus falls below 90% of the unmodified build's. It applies to
377 ready Reproduced-tier records with a seed corpus, and the developer's fix clears it in
376 (433 of 436 over all tiers). The agent setup script removes the fix
from git history and the network; the fix was unreachable in 38 of 38 sampled
images, 31 of which built. All 2158 ARVO images the scorer needed were pulled
in October 2026. Kernel records are scored by the same test in a virtual machine
(`kablate_kvm.sh` with a candidate patch); 173 Reproduced-tier kernel records are
ready by their two-sided runs on our KVM host. Scored rebuilds: a scored rebuild took a median of 88 s and used 0.8 GB (95th percentiles 20 min and 11 GB).

## S4. Further checks

| check | result |
|---|---|
| fresh-machine re-runs: projects, still Reproduced | 69 projects, 96 of 100 still Reproduced |
| rebuilt from source: built at both versions, reproduced | 13 of 60, 11 reproduced (95% CI 58–96%) |
| debugger probe: root line executed / only its function / neither / inconclusive | 363 / 74 / 6 / 331 of 774 |
| single-hunk tests re-applied with exact context: passed / kernel / unchecked | 1155 / 119 / 1 |
| tests withdrawn as applying only loosely | 46 |
| Reproduced-tier tests withdrawn as not replicated / untested because the control would not build | 4 / 4 |
| tested repair sites placed against the crash: within five lines / same function / caller on stack / off stack | 234 / 209 / 282 / 437 of 1162 |
| localization baseline (test split): crashing function / crashing file / anywhere on stack | 37% of 208 / 58% of 218 / 66% |
| root-CWE baseline (crash-type majority): after / before the CWE-20 mapping | 58% / 98% of 315 |
| sanitizer report names the root site: origin / tested | 411 of 434 / 81 of 1273 |
| MSan roots whose fix touches the origin's file | 146 of 422 |

Reproduction rules: a run that neither crashes nor shows the input completing within 600 s did not
run, is retried, and is never scored. A re-run matches the archived crash when the crash class and
the top frame in project code agree. Kernel bugs are built at the fix's parent and the fix with
syzbot's configuration and KASAN, booted under KVM, and matched by syzbot's crash class and its
function in the report title or first 12 frames, with up to three boots of each version.

## S5. Key fields of a record

| field | content |
|---|---|
| `id`, `aliases` | record id (working name `CHAINFORGE-…`); OSS-Fuzz or syzbot ids |
| `project`, `language`, `license` | upstream project, C or C++, its SPDX licence |
| `chain` | the CWE instances, root first: `cwe_id`, `role`, `site_kind`, `evidence_kind`, `evidence` (site, sanitizer report, single-hunk test) |
| `chain_string` | the chain as text, e.g. `CWE-1284->CWE-125` |
| `label_confidence_tier`, `gold_contract_gaps` | the tier, and the criteria a non-Reproduced record failed |
| `evidence_floor` | the weakest evidence category among the record's instances |
| `fix_attribution`, `root_site_relation` | whether the fix alone removes the crash; where the root site sits relative to the crash |
| `commit_range` | the fix: `fix_commits` (40-hex shas), `repo`, and `fixed` as the source gave it |
| `patch_diff`, `fix_date` | the developer's fix as a diff, and its commit date |
| `sanitizer_reports` | every run of each version, with the log path and outcome |
| `docker_image_ref`, `pov_input` | the exact vulnerable and fixed images, and the crashing input |
| `rl_ready`, `rl_scoring` | whether the patch scorer can use the record, and its scoring runs |
| `split`, `duplicate_group`, `sampling_weight` | train, validation or test; the group of records that share a fix (when there is one); project-balancing weight |
